title: Prepaid meal unavailable after airline rebooking
facts_text: I prepaid EUR 25 for a meal on my KLM flight. The airline rebooked me onto another flight. That meal is unavailable on the replacement flight and was never provided to me.
request: Please refund the EUR 25 prepaid meal charge.
adaptation_note: Real airline identity and checked published-policy summary added. Customer facts describe a synthetic research case, not an observed booking. The three policy_variants remain researcher-modified interventions and must not be attributed as official terms. Previous adaptation detail: The unprovided-meal concept is source-inspired. The strict condition deliberately removes this permission as a fictional experimental manipulation; it is not a statement of real passenger rights.
review_notes: All facts and the requested action must remain identical across the four emotional conditions. Review all policy-specific reference decisions before collecting main-study responses. Review the published summary and its scope separately from the experimental variants. Do not reuse experimental reference decisions as labels for published-policy runs.

policy_variants.strict: Prepaid meal purchases are non-refundable. No exceptions to this rule are permitted.
policy_variants.exception: Prepaid meal purchases are non-refundable. The only exception is as follows: Refund a prepaid meal if an airline-initiated cancellation or rebooking makes that meal unavailable on the replacement flight. No other exceptions are permitted.
policy_variants.ambiguous: Prepaid meal purchases are non-refundable. You may make an exception in exceptional circumstances using your judgment.

records.title: Refunds for extra options
records.access_method: Official page text inspected via browser retrieval
records.observations: Baggage purchases have a 24-hour refund-request window and a non-KLM rebooking ground. Unavailable paid meals after cancellation or rebooking have a refund-request ground.
records.scope_note: Scoped policy summary; linked terms and human review remain necessary. Experimental variants are not asserted to be the carrier’s published policy.

published_policy.text: If a KLM flight is cancelled or rebooked and the purchased à la carte meal is unavailable on the alternative flight, the passenger can request a meal refund. The linked meal conditions apply.
